# Surya Jewellers
> Surya Jewellers is a 92.5 sterling silver jewellery manufacturer based in Jaipur, India, founded in 2003 by Sanjay Chandra and Pooja Chandra. We craft handmade rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, pendants, and studs set with certified natural diamonds, rubies, emeralds, sapphires, and precious gemstones. Approximately 90% of our designs are one-piece, one-design creations. Every piece comes with a Certificate of Authenticity.
